purpose: Verify Submit Complaint main flow creates a complaint with unique ID, metadata, and optional valid attachment.
preconditions: Authenticated User / Complainant.
action_or_input: Invoke complaint submission with valid category, description, and valid attachment.
expected_result: Complaint is created in Submitted state with unique ID and stored attachment.

purpose: Verify Submit Complaint exception flow rejects missing mandatory fields or invalid attachments.
preconditions: Authenticated User / Complainant.
action_or_input: Invoke complaint submission with missing mandatory fields or disallowed attachment.
expected_result: Submission is refused without creating a complaint.

purpose: Verify Track Submitted Complaint Status and History returns current state and full history to the complainant.
preconditions: Complainant has a submitted complaint with recorded status/progress entries.
action_or_input: Complainant retrieves their complaint list and detail/history.
expected_result: Current status and chronological status/progress history are returned.

purpose: Verify Review Assigned Complaints allows an active Complaint Handler to view their assigned worklist.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler exists and complaints are assigned.
action_or_input: Complaint Handler queries assigned complaints list.
expected_result: Assigned complaints are returned to the active Handler.

purpose: Verify Assign, Categorize, and Prioritize Complaint sets handler assignment, category, and Low/Medium/High priority.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and a submitted complaint exist.
action_or_input: Handler submits handling setup with assignee, category, and priority.
expected_result: Complaint records updated handler assignment, category, and priority.

purpose: Verify Update Complaint Progress records progress notes and maintains progress history.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and an active complaint exist.
action_or_input: Handler posts a complaint progress update.
expected_result: Progress entry is appended to complaint progress history.

purpose: Verify Resolve Complaint outcome flow transitions complaint to Resolved with resolution details and triggers notification.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and unresolved complaint exist.
action_or_input: Handler resolves complaint with non-empty resolution details.
expected_result: Status becomes Resolved, resolution details are saved, and notification trigger is created.

purpose: Verify Reject Complaint outcome flow transitions complaint to Rejected with rejection reason and triggers notification.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and unresolved complaint exist.
action_or_input: Handler rejects complaint with non-empty rejection reason.
expected_result: Status becomes Rejected, rejection reason is saved, and notification trigger is created.

purpose: Verify User / Complainant closure verification transitions a Resolved complaint to Closed when complainant verification is active.
preconditions: Complaint is Resolved and closure verifier is set to complainant.
action_or_input: Owning Complainant confirms closure verification.
expected_result: Complaint transitions to Closed and history is updated.

purpose: Verify Request Complaint Reopening allows Complainant to request reopening on a Closed complaint.
preconditions: Complaint is in Closed state.
action_or_input: Owning Complainant submits a reopening request with dissatisfaction reason.
expected_result: Pending reopening request is recorded against the closed complaint.

purpose: Verify Submit Feedback allows Complainant to submit feedback on a Resolved or Closed complaint.
preconditions: Complaint is Resolved or Closed.
action_or_input: Owning Complainant submits feedback.
expected_result: Feedback record is saved and linked to the complaint.

purpose: Verify Review Submitted Feedback allows Complaint Handler and Complaint Supervisor to view feedback.
preconditions: Feedback has been submitted on a complaint.
action_or_input: Handler and Supervisor query submitted feedback.
expected_result: Submitted feedback entries are returned to Handler and Supervisor.

purpose: Verify Manually Escalate Unresolved Complaint marks complaint as escalated and triggers notification.
preconditions: Complaint is in an unresolved state.
action_or_input: Authorized actor triggers manual escalation with reason.
expected_result: Complaint is marked escalated and escalation notification trigger is recorded.

purpose: Verify Monitor Escalated Complaints allows Complaint Supervisor to view all escalated complaints.
preconditions: Active Complaint Supervisor and at least one escalated complaint exist.
action_or_input: Complaint Supervisor queries escalated complaints.
expected_result: Escalated complaints are returned to the Supervisor.

purpose: Verify Publish Complaint-Related Announcement allows Handler or Supervisor to publish an announcement.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler or Complaint Supervisor.
action_or_input: Publish complaint announcement with title and body.
expected_result: Announcement is saved and notification trigger event is created.

purpose: Verify View Complaint-Related Announcements allows Complainants to read published announcements.
preconditions: At least one published announcement exists.
action_or_input: Complainant lists complaint announcements.
expected_result: Published announcements are returned.

purpose: Verify operational reports, complaint/escalation summaries, and CMS analytics work for Handler, Supervisor, and System Admin.
preconditions: Complaints exist in the database; Handler, Supervisor, and System Admin accounts exist.
action_or_input: Handler generates operational report; Supervisor views complaint and escalation summaries; Admin views CMS reports and analytics.
expected_result: Each authorized role receives its corresponding report/summary/analytics payload.

purpose: Verify Manage CMS Roles allows System Admin to assign and reassign time-bounded Handler and Supervisor roles.
preconditions: System Admin and institutional users exist.
action_or_input: System Admin assigns Handler and Supervisor roles with duration, then reassigns them.
expected_result: Active role assignments reflect the latest holder and prior holder is deactivated.

purpose: Verify Supervisor closure verification transitions a Resolved complaint to Closed when supervisor verification is configured.
preconditions: Complaint is Resolved and closure verifier is set to supervisor.
action_or_input: Active Complaint Supervisor verifies closure.
expected_result: Complaint transitions to Closed and history is updated.

purpose: Verify Review Complaint Reopening Request handles both Supervisor approval (reopening complaint) and denial (keeping Closed).
preconditions: Closed complaint with a pending reopening request and active Complaint Supervisor.
action_or_input: Supervisor approves a reopening request on one complaint and denies a reopening request on another.
expected_result: Approved complaint reopens to configured status; denied complaint stays Closed; both decisions are audited.

purpose: Verify Trigger Pre-Breach SLA Reminder sends a reminder notification when an unresolved complaint nears its SLA deadline.
preconditions: Unresolved complaint with priority and configured SLA hours has reached the reminder window.
action_or_input: Run SLA processor.
expected_result: Pre-breach reminder notification trigger is recorded without duplicate triggers on re-run.

purpose: Verify Automatically Escalate Complaint on SLA Breach escalates an unresolved complaint once SLA duration expires.
preconditions: Unresolved complaint with priority and configured SLA hours has exceeded its SLA deadline.
action_or_input: Run SLA processor.
expected_result: Complaint is automatically escalated and escalation notification trigger is recorded.
